notes.title: TRUXTON EXTREME Demo available now!
notes.content:
Retro Fury, Modern Firepower! 


It’s finally here! One of gaming’s most iconic franchises has returned bigger, better and more Extreme than ever before!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45245741/b707d4e3b921fd490655ed7449f6c713ea79eadf.png

Dodge countless shots, unleash your spaceship's destructive power, and annihilate wave after wave of hostile aliens in the explosive vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up that is Truxton Extreme!

Truxton is one of Toaplan's great classics, which says a lot considering their catalog also includes shoot 'em up juggernauts like Batsugun, Zero Wing, and many others.

Brought to you by Tatsujin, founded by Toaplan executive Masahiro Yuge, this new edition to a legendary franchise is an evolution of Truxton. It’s packed with great features, new graphics, new sounds, even a brand new interactive digital comic! 

Why not to try it for yourself? Truxton Extreme has a demo available throughout Next Fest. check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642820/Truxton_Extreme_Demo/

This demo version includes a limited set of features to give you a good feel for Truxton Extreme ahead of its full release. (It also lets you face off against an iconic boss returning from the original game...)

So, what are you waiting for? Go play Truxton Extreme!

notes.title: Introducing the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection
notes.content:
Introducing the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection
The Japanese studios Toaplan and Psikyo created some of the most groundbreaking and greatest shoot ‘em up games from the early 80’s and up until the start of the 2000’s including beloved series such as Truxton and Strikers 1945.

We’re now teaming up with City Connection to bring you the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection! This bundle includes 16 games from Toaplan and 9 games from Psikyo filled with fast-flying bullets and bombastic bombing action.

If you already own some of these games, then you will just pay and receive the games in the bundle that you don’t already have in your Steam library. Take the chance to enjoy some of the finest arcade experiences from the golden era – updated with modern features.

Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot 'em up Collection

GAMES INCLUDED

Toaplan games:


 Batsugun
 Truxton
 Truxton II
 Zero Wing
 Out Zone
 FixEight
 Dogyuun
 Grind Stormer
 Vimana
 Slap Fight
 Tiger Heli
 Twin Cobra
 Flying Shark
 Fire Shark
 Hellfire
 Twin Hawk


Psikyo games:


 Strikers 1945
 Strikers 1945 II
 Strikers 1945 III
 Gunbird
 Gunbird 2
 Gunbarich
 Samurai Aces
 Tengai
 Samurai Aces III: Sengoku Cannon


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/c019c1fdce51060416087563fb16b0a6ed417d5c.png

Psikyo was a Japanese developer and publisher founded in 1992. Specializing in vertically scrolling shoot ‘em up that are known for fast-flying enemy bullets, challenging second loops, and enigmatic characters. Development studio Zerodiv, part of City Connection, have carefully ported Psikyo’s classic arcade games to PC.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/b475adada233a8f922ba57c9ab93093303341d1b.png

Toaplan was a Japanese developer that operated between 1984 and 1994. Famous for popularizing the bomb-based gameplay system that became a staple in shoot ‘em ups, and perfectly balanced enemy placement and attack patterns that required a strategic approach. Today Toaplan is curated by Tatsujin with many of the former key Toaplan staff employed at Tatsujin. Bitwave have ported Toaplan’s slate of immortal shoot ‘em ups to PC.

notes.title: The final Toaplan volume is out now!
notes.content:
They're here and we couldn't be more delighted! Toaplan Arcade Shoot 'Em Up Collection Vol.4 has landed on Steam and GOG, featuring heavy hitters such as Truxton II, Grind Stormer, Dogyuun, and Twin Hawk. We’re also launching an Ultimate Collection with all 16 games for the unrivaled Toaplan experience.

The Toaplan PC project was announced back in August 2022, and the circle is now complete. At Bitwave, we take great pride in our collaboration with Tatsujin, aiding them in continuing the Toaplan legacy making games like Dogyuun available in home versions for the first time.

SHMUPS INCLUDED IN VOL.4‍‍

Truxton II: Enjoy the visually stunning pixel graphics in one of the hardest and most unforgiving Toaplan games!‍

Grind Stormer: Experience a vertically scrolling manic shooter featuring impressive pixel art graphics and an upbeat FM soundtrack!‍

Dogyuun: Known for its detailed pixel art, colossal bosses, and menacing difficulty. Take on the challenge with a friend and combine your ships into a space-wrecking vehicle!‍

Twin Hawk: Call in a formation of six friendly fighter planes and take down powerful enemies in this classic military-themed shoot 'em up!

‍COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION‍

You can purchase all four games together for 19.99$/€ or separately for 7.79$/€. Complete your collection by diving into our Ultimate Collection or buy them all for 69.99$/€.‍

LIST OF UPDATES:


 Minimal Input Lag: Emulation, input processing, and rendering all complete on the same frame.
 Quick Save using F1-F10, Reload with Shift+ F1-F10.
 Online leaderboards for Single Credit, No Assist, and Assisted plays.
 Rewind the game between 10-18 minutes, depending on the action.
 Capture sharable replays to immortalize your interstellar victories (or funny moments).
 Assist Features such as auto-fire at multiple rates.
 Very Easy Mode: Lower the difficulty to breeze through the adventure.
 Pixel perfect or full-screen scaling in windowed or full-screen mode.
 Rotate the gameplay in 90-degree increments.
 Steam Achievements.
 Choose between Raw Input on Windows or Steam Input.
 Hone your skills in the ultra customizable practice mode!


Follow us on X (formerly known as Twitter) (@bitwavegames) to stay updated on future projects!

notes.title: The new Toaplan volume is out now!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/304248c697ba25d478a79249ad99c56fe7b65cb9.png

Today marks an exciting milestone! The Toaplan Arcade Shoot ‘Em Up Collection Vol. 4 is officially released on both Steam and GOG. This volume holds special significance as it includes two games that have never seen an official release outside the arcade until now: Vimana and FixEight. Additionally, experience the classic chopper shooter Tiger-Heli and the fan-favorite Batsugun.

The Games In Detail

Tiger-Heli: This is where it all started. Tiger-Heli, Toaplan's pioneering bomb-based vertical shooter set the stage for an entire genre back in 1985!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SG9XHhx19-k

Vimana: Uncover the magic of Indian mythology, unique power-ups, and an enchanting soundtrack in this electrifying space showdown!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXcYaaL2oFI

FixEight: Toaplan's thrilling vertical run-and-gun game features eight peerless warriors with cutting-edge weapons!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xcSceYUoEJM

Batsugun: The epic conclusion of Toaplan's legendary shooter series. Play the original or Batsugun Special. Choose your favorite character and spaceship in this thrilling sci-fi adventure!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UjVc76ROHxI

You can purchase all four games together for 19.99$/€ or separately for 7.79$/€! Each game features quick save/resume, online leaderboards for single credit players, no assist and assisted modes, and Achievements (for bragging rights)! You can also showcase your skills online using the built-in video capture!

List of updates:


 Minimal Input Lag: Emulation, input processing, and rendering all complete on the same frame.
 Quick Save using F1-F10, Reload with Shift+ F1-F10
 Online leaderboards for Single Credit, No Assist, and Assisted plays.
 Instrument panels with extra gameplay information and artwork.
 Rewind the game between 10-18 minutes, depending on the action.
 Capture sharable replays to immortalize your interstellar victories (or funny moments).
 Assist Features such as auto-fire at multiple rates.
 Very Easy Mode: Lower the difficulty to breeze through the adventure.
 Pixel perfect or full-screen scaling in windowed or full-screen mode.
 Rotate the gameplay in 90-degree increments.
 Steam Achievements
 Choose between Raw Input on Windows or Steam Input.
 Hone your skills in the ultra-customizable practice mode!


With Vol.3 out, there’s just one more to go! Look forward to Truxton II, Dogyuun, Grind Stormer, and Twin Hawk. But more on that later.

Follow us on X (formerly known as Twitter) to stay updated!
